"""Differential fuzz: compressed project parser vs independent reference."""
import random, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/project')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/mytests')
from modules import byte_program as bp
from modules.capture_audit import parse_requests, Budget, BudgetError
import ref_parser as ref


def rand_request(rnd):
    method = rnd.choice([b'GET', b'POST', b'PUT', b'X', b'HEAD', b'M-1_2'])
    target = rnd.choice([b'/', b'/a/b', b'/x?y=1', b'/%20', b'/long' + b'z' * rnd.randrange(0, 20)])
    lines = [method + b' ' + target + b' HTTP/1.1\r\n']
    fields = []
    n = rnd.randrange(0, 4)
    for _ in range(n):
        nm = rnd.choice([b'Host', b'host', b'HOST', b'X-A', b'Accept', b'Content-Type', b'x' * rnd.randrange(1, 5)])
        vl = rnd.choice([b'h.example', b' a b ', b'', b'\tv\t', b'value', b'a' * rnd.randrange(0, 10)])
        fields.append(nm + b':' + vl + b'\r\n')
    mode = rnd.choice(['none', 'length', 'chunked', 'length', 'none'])
    body = bytes(rnd.randrange(256) for _ in range(rnd.randrange(0, 8)))
    if mode == 'length':
        fields.append(b'Content-Length: ' + str(len(body)).encode() + b'\r\n')
        if rnd.random() < 0.2:
            fields.append(b'content-length: ' + str(len(body)).encode() + b'\r\n')
        payload = body
    elif mode == 'chunked':
        fields.append(b'Transfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n')
        chunks = []
        acc = b''
        for _ in range(rnd.randrange(0, 4)):
            size = rnd.randrange(0, 5)
            piece = bytes(rnd.randrange(256) for _ in range(size))
            suffix = rnd.choice([b'', b';ext=1', b'; a b', b';\t'])
            chunks.append(('%x' % size).encode() + suffix + b'\r\n' + piece + (b'\r\n' if size else b''))
            acc += piece
        trailers = b''
        if rnd.random() < 0.4:
            for _ in range(rnd.randrange(1, 3)):
                trailers += rnd.choice([b'T-x: 1\r\n', b'Trail: v v\r\n'])
        chunks.append(b'0\r\n' + trailers + b'\r\n')
        payload = b''.join(chunks)
        body = acc
    else:
        payload = b''
        body = b''
    return b''.join(lines) + b''.join(fields) + b'\r\n' + payload


def rand_channel(rnd):
    parts = []
    for _ in range(rnd.randrange(1, 4)):
        parts.append(rand_request(rnd))
    data = b''.join(parts)
    style = rnd.random()
    if style < 0.25 and data:
        data = data[:rnd.randrange(0, len(data))]
    elif style < 0.5 and data:
        i = rnd.randrange(len(data))
        data = data[:i] + bytes([rnd.randrange(256)]) + data[i + 1:]
    elif style < 0.6 and data:
        i = rnd.randrange(len(data))
        data = data[:i] + data[i + 1:]
    elif style < 0.7:
        data = data + bytes(rnd.randrange(256) for _ in range(rnd.randrange(0, 5)))
    return data


def compare(data, seed):
    budget = Budget()
    try:
        mine, my_err = parse_requests(bp.literal(data), budget)
    except BudgetError:
        mine, my_err = 'BUDGET', None
    rb = {'requests': 0, 'chunk': 0}
    try:
        theirs, their_err = ref.parse(data, rb)
    except ValueError:
        theirs, their_err = 'BUDGET', None
    if mine == 'BUDGET' or theirs == 'BUDGET':
        assert mine == theirs, (seed, data, mine, theirs)
        return
    clean = []
    for r in mine:
        clean.append({k: v for k, v in r.items() if not k.endswith('_bytes')})
    assert clean == theirs, (seed, data, clean, theirs)
    assert my_err == their_err, (seed, data, my_err, their_err)


def main(n=4000):
    for seed in range(n):
        rnd = random.Random(seed)
        data = rand_channel(rnd)
        compare(data, seed)
    print('differential parse OK for', n, 'random captures')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 4000)
